name: Nkwadebe maka Ule GED: Social Studies (Ọmụmụ Obodo)
objectives: Site n'iji weebụsaịtị GED gọọmentị, ịkpọ aha akụkụ, ụdị ajụjụ, oge na ngwa nke ule GED Social Studies ma dee atụmatụ ọmụmụ nwere ụbọchị, ma kpọọ aha mpaghara nka atọ ahụ, na opekata mpe otu ụbọchị ọmụmụ kwa izu ruo ụbọchị ule
Mgbe e nyere gị isi iyi mbụ ma ọ bụ nke abụọ, ịmata isi okwu, echiche onye dere ya, na okwu ndị bụ eziokwu na ndị bụ echiche, ma gosi okwu ndị na-egosi azịza ọ bụla
Mgbe e nyere gị obere ọnọdụ civics, ịkọwa ngalaba gọọmentị na-eme ihe na otu checks and balances ma ọ bụ ikike nke Constitution si metụta ya, ma nweta opekata mpe 4 n'ime 5 ziri ezi
Mgbe e nyere gị ihe mere n'akụkọ ihe mere eme ma ọ bụ arụmụka, ịmata ihe kpatara, ihe si na ya pụta, na ihe akaebe na-akwado inference, ma kpọọ aha ihe akaebe ahụ site n'isi iyi ahụ

Mgbe e nyere gị maapụ, chaatị ma ọ bụ graf gbasara akụkọ ihe mere eme, akụnụba ma ọ bụ ọdịdị ala, ịgụ ọnụ ọgụgụ, ịkọwa ụzọ ọ na-aga, na ịhọrọ nkwubi okwu data ahụ na-akwado, n'etinyeghị eziokwu ndị a na-egosighị

chapters.name: Isi 1: Ịgụ isi iyi na otu gọọmentị si arụ ọrụ

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 1: Otu ule GED Social Studies si arụ ọrụ
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 1 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Kpọọ aha akụkụ na ngwa nke ule GED Social Studies ma dee atụmatụ ọmụmụ nwere ụbọchị.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Site n'iji weebụsaịtị GED gọọmentị, ị ga-enwe ike ịkpọ aha akụkụ, ụdị ajụjụ, oge na ngwa nke ule GED Social Studies ma dee atụmatụ ọmụmụ nwere ụbọchị, ma kpọọ aha mpaghara nka atọ ahụ, na opekata mpe otu ụbọchị ọmụmụ kwa izu ruo ụbọchị ule.
GED nwere ule anọ: Math, Reasoning Through Language Arts, Science na Social Studies. Ị nwere ike ide ha otu n'otu. GED Testing Service na-eme ule ahụ. Steeti ụfọdụ na-eji ule ọzọ kwesịrị ụlọ akwụkwọ sekọndrị (high school equivalency), HiSET, ya mere lelee ule steeti gị na-eji.
Na ged.com, e dere na ule Social Studies bụ nkeji 70 n'enweghị ezumike. Ọ na-agụnye mpaghara nka atọ: ịgụ ihe maka ịghọta ya na social studies, inyocha ihe mere n'akụkọ ihe mere eme na arụmụka, na iji ọnụ ọgụgụ na graf na social studies. Ajụjụ bụ multiple choice (ịhọrọ otu), fill in the blank (mejupụta oghere), drag and drop (dọkpụrụ tinye), select an area (họrọ otu ebe) na drop-down.
A na-enye gị calculator dị n'ihuenyo na mpempe ntụaka calculator, ged.com kwukwara na ị nwere ike iweta calculator TI-30XS nke gị n'ebe ule. Ged.com kwuru na ọ bụghị ule ịchekwa ihe n'isi: ị na-eji ozi e nyere gị wee mee nkwubi okwu.
Ged.com depụtara akara ngafe 145 maka isiokwu ọ bụla. Oge na iwu nwere ike ịgbanwe, ya mere lelee ged.com tupu i debe oge. Ged.com nwere ule nlele n'efu na ule omume gọọmentị, GED Ready.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Gaa na ged.com ma gụọ peeji ule Social Studies.
- Dee oge ya, mpaghara nka atọ ahụ na ngwa a na-enye gị.
- Dee ule nlele Social Studies n'efu ka ị hụ ebe ị nọ.
- Họrọ izu ị chọrọ ide ule.
- Dee opekata mpe otu ụbọchị ọmụmụ kwa izu, ya na nka ị ga-amụ.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- GED: ule kwesịrị ụlọ akwụkwọ sekọndrị; ịgafe isiokwu anọ niile na-enye asambodo nke ọtụtụ ndị were mmadụ n'ọrụ na kọleji na-anabata dị ka diploma.
- HiSET: ule ọzọ kwesịrị ụlọ akwụkwọ sekọndrị nke steeti ụfọdụ na-eji.
- Civics: ọmụmụ gọọmentị na ikike na ọrụ ụmụ amaala.
- Economics (akụnụba): ọmụmụ otu ndị mmadụ si emepụta, zụta, ree ma jiri ngwongwo na ego.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- GED Testing Service: test subjects (time, question types, calculator)
- GED Testing Service: Social Studies test
- GED Testing Service: scores
- GED Testing Service: free sample tests (English and Spanish)
- GED Ready, the official practice test
- HiSET, another high school equivalency test (official site)
Nwaa ugbu a: Meghee ged.com ma dee ule nlele Social Studies n'efu (ma ọ bụ gụọ peeji Social Studies ma ọ bụrụ na ịnweghị ike ide ya ugbu a). Dee atụmatụ ọmụmụ gị: izu ị chọrọ ide ule na otu ụbọchị kwa izu ya na nka ị ga-amụ: ịgụ isi iyi, gọọmentị, akụkọ ihe mere eme, ma ọ bụ graf. Debe ya maka ọrụ ikpeazụ.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịkpọ aha akụkụ na ngwa nke ule GED Social Studies ma soro atụmatụ ọmụmụ nwere ụbọchị.

check.q: Gịnị ka ged.com kwuru gbasara ule Social Studies?
options: Ọ bụghị ule ịchekwa ihe n'isi
Ọ bụ naanị gbasara mba ndị ọzọ
check.why: Ged.com kwuru na ọ bụghị ule ịchekwa ihe n'isi; ị na-eji ozi e nyere gị echiche ihe.

check.q: Kedu nke bụ otu n'ime mpaghara nka atọ dị n'ule ahụ?
options: Iji ọnụ ọgụgụ na graf na social studies
check.why: Ged.com depụtara ịgụ ihe maka ịghọta ya, ihe mere n'akụkọ ihe mere eme na arụmụka, na ọnụ ọgụgụ na graf.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 2: Isi iyi, echiche onye dere ya, eziokwu na echiche
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 2 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Mata isi okwu, echiche onye dere ya, eziokwu na echiche dị n'isi iyi.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị isi iyi mbụ ma ọ bụ nke abụọ, ị ga-enwe ike ịmata isi okwu, echiche onye dere ya, na okwu ndị bụ eziokwu na ndị bụ echiche, ma gosi okwu ndị na-egosi azịza ọ bụla.
Isi iyi mbụ (primary source) bụ ihe onye nọ ebe ahụ n'oge ahụ mere: akwụkwọ ozi, okwu a kwuru n'ihu ọha, iwu, foto, akwụkwọ ndetu kwa ụbọchị. Isi iyi nke abụọ (secondary source) bụ ihe onye na-amụ ihe ahụ mere mere emesịa, dị ka akwụkwọ ọgụgụ ma ọ bụ nyocha akụkọ ụwa. Ha abụọ bara uru; isi iyi mbụ na-egosi otu ndị mmadụ si hụ ihe n'oge ahụ.
Echiche onye dere ya (point of view) bụ otu onye dere ya si ahụ isiokwu ahụ, dabere n'onye ọ bụ na ihe ọ chọrọ. Jụọ: onye dere nke a, mgbe ole, gịnị kpatara? Onye nwe ụlọ ọrụ mmepụta na onye ọrụ n'ụlọ ọrụ ahụ n'afọ 1900 nwere ike ịkọwa otu ngagharị iwe ndị ọrụ (strike) n'ụzọ dị iche nke ukwuu.
Eziokwu (fact) bụ ihe a pụrụ ilele ma gosi na ọ bụ eziokwu ma ọ bụ ụgha: "E kwadoro 19th Amendment n'afọ 1920." Echiche (opinion) bụ ihe mmadụ kwenyere ma ọ bụ mmetụta: "Ọ bụ mgbanwe kacha mkpa n'akụkọ ihe mere eme anyị." Okwu dị ka kacha mma, kacha njọ, kwesịrị, dị mkpa na ekwenyere m na-egosikarị echiche.
Ihe atụ a rụrụ arụ. Mgbasa ozi akwụkwọ akụkọ n'afọ 1910: "Igwe ọhụrụ anyị na-emepụta uwe elu 500 kwa ụbọchị. Ezinụlọ ọ bụla nke oge a kwesịrị ịzụta uwe elu anyị!" Eziokwu: uwe elu 500 kwa ụbọchị (a pụrụ ilele ya). Echiche: ezinụlọ ọ bụla kwesịrị ịzụta ha. Echiche onye dere ya: azụmahịa na-ere ngwongwo ya.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Jụọ onye mere isi iyi ahụ, mgbe ole na gịnị kpatara.
- Kpebie: mbụ (e mere ya n'oge ahụ) ma ọ bụ nke abụọ (e mere ya emesịa).
- Kwuo isi okwu ya n'otu ahịrịokwu.
- Kaa okwu ọ bụla akara eziokwu (a pụrụ ilele ya) ma ọ bụ echiche (nkwenye ma ọ bụ ikpe).
- Kọwaa echiche onye dere ya na ihe ọ chọrọ ka onye na-agụ ya mee ma ọ bụ chee.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Isi iyi mbụ (primary source): ihe e mere n'oge ihe mere, site n'aka onye nọ ebe ahụ.
- Isi iyi nke abụọ (secondary source): ihe e mere emesịa site n'aka onye na-amụ ihe ahụ mere.
- Echiche onye dere ya (point of view): otu onye dere ya si ahụ isiokwu, dabere n'onye ọ bụ na ihe ọ chọrọ.
- Eziokwu (fact): okwu a pụrụ ilele ma gosi.
- Echiche (opinion): nkwenye, mmetụta ma ọ bụ ikpe mmadụ.
Nwaa ugbu a: Omume: akwụkwọ ozi onye ọrụ ugbo dere n'afọ 1935: "Oké ifufe ájá liri ubi anyị ugboro atọ n'oge opupu ihe ubi a. Gọọmentị kwesịrị inyere ndị ọrụ ugbo dị ka anyị aka tupu oge agafee." 1) Mbụ ka ọ bụ nke abụọ? 2) Otu eziokwu. 3) Otu echiche. 4) Echiche onye dere ya? Azịza: 1) Mbụ: onye nọ ebe ahụ dere ya n'oge ahụ. 2) Oké ifufe ájá liri ubi ahụ ugboro atọ n'oge opupu ihe ubi ahụ. 3) Gọọmentị kwesịrị inyere ndị ọrụ ugbo aka. 4) Onye ọrụ ugbo nọ na nsogbu na-arịọ enyemaka.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịmata ọdịiche dị n'etiti isi iyi mbụ na nke abụọ, ịkọwa echiche onye dere ya, na ikewa eziokwu na echiche.

check.q: Kedu nke bụ isi iyi mbụ gbasara Agha Ụwa nke Abụọ?
options: Isi akwụkwọ ọgụgụ e dere n'afọ 2020
Nchịkọta weebụsaịtị e dere n'afọ gara aga
Akwụkwọ ozi onye agha degaara ndị ụlọ ya n'afọ 1944
check.why: Onye nọ ebe ahụ mere ya n'oge ahụ.

options: Obodo ahụ nwere ndị bi na ya 40,000.
Nke ahụ bụ iwu kacha mma Congress gafere.
check.why: "Kacha mma" bụ ikpe a na-apụghị igosi.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 3: Otu gọọmentị US si arụ ọrụ
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 3 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Kọwaa ngalaba gọọmentị na-eme ihe n'otu ọnọdụ na otu checks and balances si metụta ya.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị obere ọnọdụ civics, ị ga-enwe ike ịkọwa ngalaba gọọmentị na-eme ihe na otu checks and balances ma ọ bụ ikike nke Constitution si metụta ya, ma nweta opekata mpe 4 n'ime 5 ziri ezi.
US Constitution kewara gọọmentị etiti (federal) ụzọ atọ ka mmadụ ma ọ bụ otu ọ bụla ghara inwe ike karịrị akarị. Ngalaba omebe iwu (legislative) bụ Congress (Senate na House of Representatives); ọ na-eme iwu. Ngalaba nchịkwa (executive) bụ onye isi ala (president), osote onye isi ala na cabinet; ọ na-emejuputa iwu. Ngalaba ikpe (judicial) bụ Supreme Court na ụlọikpe federal ndị ọzọ; ha na-akọwa iwu ma kpebie ma iwu ọ na-emegide Constitution.
Checks and balances (nlekọta na nhazi ike) na-ekwe ka ngalaba ọ bụla gbochie ndị ọzọ. Onye isi ala nwere ike ịjụ (veto) bill Congress gafere. Senate na-akwado ma ọ bụ jụ ndị onye isi ala họpụtara, dị ka ndị ọka ikpe federal. Supreme Court nwere ike ịkagbu iwu ọ hụrụ na ọ na-emegide Constitution. Congress nwere ike, n'ọnọdụ siri ike, iwepụ onye isi ala n'ọchịchị.
Bill of Rights bụ mgbanwe (amendments) iri mbụ nke Constitution. Ọ na-echebe ikike dị ka nnwere onwe ikwu okwu, okpukpe, ndị nta akụkọ na nzukọ (First Amendment), na ikike ndị a na-ebo ebubo mpụ, dị ka ikpe ziri ezi na ngwa ngwa. A na-ekekọrịtakwa ike n'etiti gọọmentị federal na steeti; a na-akpọ nke a federalism.
Ihe atụ a rụrụ arụ. "Congress gafere bill. Onye isi ala jụrụ ya (veto)." Kedu check nke a bụ? Ngalaba nchịkwa na-enyocha ngalaba omebe iwu.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Chọta onye na-eme ihe: Congress, onye isi ala ma ọ bụ ụlọikpe.
- Kpọọ aha ngalaba ahụ: omebe iwu, nchịkwa ma ọ bụ ikpe.
- Jụọ ike a na-eji: ime iwu, imejuputa iwu ma ọ bụ ịkọwa iwu.
- Ọ bụrụ na otu ngalaba na-egbochi ọzọ, kpọọ aha check ahụ.
- Ọ bụrụ na ikike mmadụ metụtara ya, chọọ ikike ahụ na Bill of Rights.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Constitution: iwu kacha elu na United States; ọ na-ehiwe gọọmentị.
- Ngalaba omebe iwu (legislative): Congress; ọ na-eme iwu.
- Ngalaba nchịkwa (executive): onye isi ala, osote onye isi ala na cabinet; ọ na-emejuputa iwu.
- Ngalaba ikpe (judicial): ụlọikpe; ha na-akọwa iwu.
- Veto: mgbe onye isi ala jụrụ bill Congress gafere.
- Amendment: mgbanwe ma ọ bụ mgbakwunye na Constitution.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- USAGov: Branches of the U.S. government
- National Archives: The Constitution of the United States (transcript)
- National Archives: The Bill of Rights (transcript)
Nwaa ugbu a: Omume: kpọọ aha ngalaba ma ọ bụ ikike. 1) Senate na-atụ vootu na onye onye isi ala họpụtara ka ọ bụrụ ọka ikpe federal. 2) Supreme Court kpebiri na iwu na-emebi Constitution. 3) Akwụkwọ akụkọ bipụtara akụkọ na-akatọ onye isi obodo (mayor). 4) Onye isi ala bịanyere aka na bill ka ọ bụrụ iwu. Azịza: 1) Omebe iwu na-enyocha nchịkwa. 2) Ikpe na-enyocha omebe iwu. 3) Nnwere onwe ndị nta akụkọ, First Amendment. 4) Nchịkwa (na-arụ ọrụ ya n'ime iwu).
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịkpọ aha ngalaba atọ ahụ, ịkọwa checks and balances n'otu ọnọdụ, na ijikọ ọnọdụ na Bill of Rights.

check.why: Congress, ngalaba omebe iwu, na-eme iwu.

check.q: Supreme Court kpebiri na iwu na-emegide Constitution. Gịnị ka nke a bụ ihe atụ ya?
options: Check ngalaba ikpe na-eme na ngalaba omebe iwu
check.why: Ụlọikpe nwere ike ịkagbu iwu na-emegide Constitution.

chapters.name: Isi 2: Akụkọ ihe mere eme, akụnụba na graf

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 4: Ihe kpatara, ihe si na ya pụta na ihe akaebe n'akụkọ ihe mere eme
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 4 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Mata ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta n'ihe mere n'akụkọ ihe mere eme, na ihe akaebe na-akwado inference.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị ihe mere n'akụkọ ihe mere eme ma ọ bụ arụmụka, ị ga-enwe ike ịmata ihe kpatara, ihe si na ya pụta, na ihe akaebe na-akwado inference, ma kpọọ aha ihe akaebe ahụ site n'isi iyi ahụ.
Ajụjụ akụkọ ihe mere eme na-ajụkarị ihe mere otu ihe ji mee (ihe kpatara ya, cause) na ihe mere n'ihi ya (ihe si na ya pụta, effect). Okwu ngosi: n'ihi na, ya mere, n'ihi nke a, dugara na, ya bụ, n'ihi.
Ihe atụ a rụrụ arụ. "Na njedebe afọ 1800s, ụlọ ọrụ mmepụta n'obodo mepere emepe nyere ọtụtụ ọrụ ọhụrụ. N'ihi nke a, ọtụtụ nde mmadụ si n'ugbo kwaga n'obodo mepere emepe. Ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị bi n'obodo ahụ toro ngwa ngwa, ebe obibi juru oke wee bụrụ nsogbu." Ihe kpatara: ọrụ ụlọ ọrụ mmepụta n'obodo. Ihe si na ya pụta: ndị mmadụ kwagara n'obodo. Ihe si na ya pụta emesịa: ebe obibi juru oke. Otu ihe kpatara nwere ike iduga n'usoro ihe ndị si na ya pụta.
Inference bụ nkwubi okwu ihe akaebe na-akwado. Ajụjụ GED nwere ike ịjụ okwu dị n'isi iyi na-akwado inference. Họrọ okwu na-enye ihe akaebe, ọ bụghị naanị nke gbasara otu isiokwu ahụ.
Kpachara anya: ihe abụọ imee n'otu oge apụtaghị mgbe niile na otu kpatara nke ọzọ. Chọọ ka isi iyi ahụ kwuo ma ọ bụ gosi njikọ ahụ.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Chọta ihe mere ajụjụ ahụ na-ajụ.
- Chọọ okwu ngosi: n'ihi na, ya mere, n'ihi nke a, dugara na.
- Kpọọ aha ihe kpatara (gịnị mere) na ihe si na ya pụta (ihe mere ọzọ).
- Maka inference, họrọ okwu na-enye ihe akaebe maka ya.
- Lelee na isi iyi ahụ jikọrọ ha abụọ n'ezie; echela n'onwe gị.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Ihe kpatara (cause): ihe mere otu ihe ji mee.
- Ihe si na ya pụta (effect): ihe mere n'ihi ihe kpatara ya.
- Inference: nkwubi okwu ihe akaebe na-akwado.
- Industrialization: uto ụlọ ọrụ mmepụta na igwe na-emepụta ngwongwo.
Nwaa ugbu a: Omume: "Dust Bowl nke afọ 1930s bibiri ihe ọkụkụ na Great Plains. Ọtụtụ ezinụlọ ndị ọrụ ugbo tụfuru ala ha ma kwaga ọdịda anyanwụ ịchọ ọrụ." 1) Ihe kpatara? 2) Ihe si na ya pụta? 3) Kedu okwu kacha akwado inference "Dust Bowl gbanwere ebe ndị mmadụ bi": (a) "Dust Bowl bibiri ihe ọkụkụ" ma ọ bụ (b) "Ọtụtụ ezinụlọ ndị ọrụ ugbo kwagara ọdịda anyanwụ"? Azịza: 1) Oké ifufe ájá bibiri ihe ọkụkụ. 2) Ezinụlọ tụfuru ala ma kwaga ọdịda anyanwụ. 3) (b): ọ na-egosi ndị mmadụ na-akwaga.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịchọta ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta n'akụkọ ihe mere eme ma họrọ ihe akaebe na-akwado inference.

check.q: "Ọnụ ahịa mmanụ ụgbọala rịgoro nke ukwuu, ya mere ọtụtụ mmadụ banyere bọs." Gịnị bụ ihe si na ya pụta?
check.why: Ịbanye bọs bụ ihe mere n'ihi na ọnụ ahịa mmanụ ụgbọala rịgoro.

check.q: Kedu okwu kacha akwado inference na okporo ụzọ ọhụrụ nyeere azụmahịa obodo aka?
options: "Ihe ụlọ ahịa obodo ahụ rere mụbara okpukpu abụọ n'ime afọ ise mgbe okporo ụzọ ahụ meghere."
check.why: Ọ na-enye ihe akaebe nke uto azụmahịa jikọrọ okporo ụzọ ahụ.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 5: Akụnụba na graf
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 5 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Gụọ chaatị ma ọ bụ maapụ, kọwaa ụzọ ọ na-aga ma họrọ nkwubi okwu data ahụ na-akwado.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị maapụ, chaatị ma ọ bụ graf gbasara akụkọ ihe mere eme, akụnụba ma ọ bụ ọdịdị ala, ị ga-enwe ike ịgụ ọnụ ọgụgụ, ịkọwa ụzọ ọ na-aga, na ịhọrọ nkwubi okwu data ahụ na-akwado, n'etinyeghị eziokwu ndị a na-egosighị.
Supply (ihe dị maka ire) bụ ole ihe dị maka ire. Demand (ihe a chọrọ) bụ ole ndị mmadụ chọrọ ịzụta. Mgbe demand rịgoro ma supply ka dị otu ahụ, ọnụ ahịa na-arịgokarị. Mgbe supply rịgoro ma demand ka dị otu ahụ, ọnụ ahịa na-adakarị. Ihe atụ: mgbe oyi siri ike mebiri ihe ọkụkụ oroma, supply oroma na-ada, ọnụ ahịa ya na-arịgo.
Graf: buru ụzọ gụọ aha ya, labels na units. Tebụl omume (e mepụtara ya): ọnụ ọgụgụ enweghị ọrụ (unemployment rate) n'otu obodo bụ 8% n'afọ 2020, 6% n'afọ 2021, 5% n'afọ 2022 na 4% n'afọ 2023. Ụzọ ọ na-aga: na-ada kwa afọ. Nkwubi okwu a kwadoro: n'afọ 2023, akụkụ pere mpe nke ndị na-achọ ọrụ enweghị ọrụ karịa n'afọ 2020. A kwadoghị: ihe mere o ji daa, n'ihi na tebụl ahụ ekwughị.
Maapụ: gụọ aha ya, legend (igodo) na compass rose. Legend na-agwa gị ihe agba ma ọ bụ akara pụtara. Maapụ mmiri ozuzo nwere ike iji agba gbara ọchịchịrị karịa maka mmiri ozuzo karịrị. Jiri scale chọpụta ihe dị ka anya dị n'etiti ebe abụọ.
Mgbanwe pasentị na-adịkarị: site na 8% ruo 4% bụ ọdịda nke percentage points 4. Ị nwere ike iji calculator dị n'ihuenyo maka mgbakọ ahụ.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Gụọ aha ya, labels, units ma ọ bụ legend maapụ.
- Chọta ọnụ ọgụgụ ajụjụ ahụ na-ajụ.
- Kọwaa ụzọ ọ na-aga: na-arịgo, na-ada ma ọ bụ enweghị usoro doro anya.
- Họrọ nkwubi okwu na-anọ n'ime data ahụ.
- Maka ọnụ ahịa, jụọ: supply ka ọ bụ demand gbanwere?
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Supply: ole ngwongwo ma ọ bụ ọrụ dị maka ire.
- Demand: ole ndị mmadụ chọrọ ịzụta ya.
- Unemployment rate: akụkụ ndị na-achọ ọrụ na-enweghị ọrụ.
- Legend: igodo dị na maapụ ma ọ bụ chaatị na-agwa ihe agba ma ọ bụ akara pụtara.
- Percentage point: ọdịiche dị mfe n'etiti pasentị abụọ, dị ka 8% ruo 4% bụ points 4.
Nwaa ugbu a: Omume (data e mepụtara): chaatị bar na-egosi ụgwọ ụlọ (rent) kwa ọnwa n'otu obodo: 2019: $1,000; 2021: $1,150; 2023: $1,400. 1) Ụgwọ ụlọ n'afọ 2021? 2) Ụzọ ọ na-aga? 3) Ole ka ụgwọ ụlọ rịgoro site n'afọ 2019 ruo 2023? 4) Kedu nkwubi okwu a kwadoro: (a) ụgwọ ụlọ rịgoro n'oge a, ma ọ bụ (b) ụgwọ ụlọ rịgoro n'ihi ọrụ ọhụrụ? Azịza: 1) $1,150. 2) Na-arịgo. 3) $400. 4) (a); chaatị ahụ egosighị ihe kpatara ya.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike iji supply na demand kọwaa mgbanwe ọnụ ahịa, ma gụọ chaatị na maapụ wee họrọ nkwubi okwu a kwadoro.

check.q: Oké ifufe mebiri ọtụtụ ụlọ ọrụ na-egbu osisi, ya mere osisi (lumber) dị maka ire belatara ebe ndị na-ewu ụlọ ka chọrọ ya. Gịnị na-emekarị ọnụ ahịa osisi?
check.why: Supply dara ebe demand nọ otu ahụ, ya mere ọnụ ahịa na-arịgokarị.

check.q: Na maapụ, gịnị na-agwa gị ihe agba ọ bụla pụtara?

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 6: Ijikọ ya ọnụ: inyocha akwụkwọ ntọala obodo
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 6 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Mezue mpempe akwụkwọ nyocha isi iyi gbasara akwụkwọ ntọala obodo.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị isi iyi mbụ ma ọ bụ nke abụọ, ị ga-enwe ike ịmata isi okwu, echiche onye dere ya, na okwu ndị bụ eziokwu na ndị bụ echiche, ma gosi okwu ndị na-egosi azịza ọ bụla. Mgbe e nyere gị obere ọnọdụ civics, ị ga-enwe ike ịkọwa ngalaba gọọmentị na-eme ihe na otu checks and balances ma ọ bụ ikike nke Constitution si metụta ya, ma nweta opekata mpe 4 n'ime 5 ziri ezi. Mgbe e nyere gị ihe mere n'akụkọ ihe mere eme ma ọ bụ arụmụka, ị ga-enwe ike ịmata ihe kpatara, ihe si na ya pụta, na ihe akaebe na-akwado inference, ma kpọọ aha ihe akaebe ahụ site n'isi iyi ahụ.
Ajụjụ GED na-enyekarị gị obere akụkụ nke akwụkwọ ochie ma jụọ gbasara isi okwu ya, ebumnuche ya ma ọ bụ otu o si jikọta na gọọmentị taa. Preamble, ahịrịokwu mmeghe nke Constitution, dị mma maka omume. Gụọ ya na weebụsaịtị National Archives.
Preamble na-amalite "We the People of the United States" (Anyị bụ Ndị United States) ma depụta ebumnuche: ime njikọ zuru oke karịa, iguzobe ikpe ziri ezi, ime ka udo dịrị n'ụlọ (domestic tranquility), ichebe obodo ọnụ (common defense), ịkwalite ọdịmma mmadụ niile (general welfare) na ichekwa ngọzi nke nnwere onwe.
Nyocha a rụrụ arụ. Onye na mgbe: ndị nnọchiteanya na Constitutional Convention, 1787. Ụdị: isi iyi mbụ. Isi okwu: ndị mmadụ hiwere gọọmentị iji mezuo ebumnuche ha nwere ọnụ. Echiche onye dere ya: ndị isi chọrọ gọọmentị mba siri ike karịa nke ha nwere na mbụ. Ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta: gọọmentị mbụ n'okpuru Articles of Confederation adịghị ike, nke a dugara n'ide Constitution ọhụrụ. Ngalaba: Preamble na-ewebata Constitution niile, nke na-ehiwe ngalaba atọ niile.
Mpempe akwụkwọ gị achọghị azịza zuru oke. Ọ chọrọ azịza ị nwere ike ịkwado site n'igosi okwu ndị dị n'akwụkwọ ahụ.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Meghee ederede Constitution na archives.gov ma gụọ Preamble.
- Dee onye dere ya, mgbe e dere ya, ma ọ bụ isi iyi mbụ ma ọ bụ nke abụọ.
- Dee isi okwu ya n'otu ahịrịokwu na echiche onye dere ya.
- Dee otu eziokwu gbasara ya na otu ebumnuche ma ọ bụ echiche dị n'ime ya.
- Dee otu ihe kpatara na otu ihe si na ya pụta, na ngalaba ma ọ bụ ikike o jikọrọ.
- Tinye atụmatụ ọmụmụ gị nwere ụbọchị n'ala ya.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Preamble: ahịrịokwu mmeghe nke Constitution na-ekwu ebumnuche ya.
- Articles of Confederation: atụmatụ mbụ nke gọọmentị US, nke e ji tupu Constitution.
- Domestic tranquility: udo n'ụlọ (n'ime obodo).
- General welfare: ọdịmma ndị mmadụ niile.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- National Archives: The Constitution of the United States (transcript)
- National Archives: The Bill of Rights (transcript)
Nwaa ugbu a: Ọrụ ikpeazụ: mezue mpempe akwụkwọ nyocha isi iyi otu peeji gbasara Preamble (ma ọ bụ Bill of Rights) site na archives.gov, site n'iji nzọụkwụ ndị dị n'elu. Tinye atụmatụ ọmụmụ GED gị nwere ụbọchị n'ala ya, wee jiri rubric nke ihe ọmụmụ a tụọ akara ọrụ gị.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike inyocha akwụkwọ ntọala obodo: ụdị isi iyi ya, isi okwu ya, echiche onye dere ya, ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta, na njikọ ya na otu gọọmentị si arụ ọrụ.
Otu e si enyocha ọrụ ikpeazụ gị:
Ihe anyị na-ele anya Ọ bụbeghị O ruru O karịrị Isi iyi na echiche onye dere ya Ụdị isi iyi ma ọ bụ onye dere ya ezighi ezi ma ọ bụ adịghị. Onye dere ya, ụbọchị na ụdị isi iyi ziri ezi, na echiche onye dere ya dabara n'onye dere ya na ihe mere o ji dee ya. Ọ kọwakwara otu echiche ahụ si emetụta ihe akwụkwọ ahụ na-ekwu. Isi okwu, eziokwu na echiche Isi okwu ezighi ezi, ma ọ bụ eziokwu na echiche gwakọtara. Isi okwu ziri ezi n'otu ahịrịokwu, otu eziokwu na otu ebumnuche ma ọ bụ echiche, nke ọ bụla jikọrọ okwu ndị dị n'akwụkwọ ahụ. Ọ na-ehota kpọmkwem okwu ndị na-egosi azịza ọ bụla. Ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta Enweghị ihe kpatara ma ọ bụ ihe si na ya pụta, ma ọ bụ a tụgharịrị ha. Otu ihe kpatara ziri ezi na otu ihe si na ya pụta ziri ezi jikọrọ akwụkwọ ahụ. Ọ na-egosi usoro: ihe kpatara, ihe si na ya pụta na ihe ọzọ si na ya pụta emesịa. Njikọ na gọọmentị Akpọghị aha ngalaba ma ọ bụ ikike ọ bụla, ma ọ bụ a kpọrọ nke na-ezighi ezi. Ọ kpọrọ aha ngalaba ma ọ bụ ikike ọ metụtara ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya n'otu ahịrịokwu. Ọ nyekwara ihe atụ nke checks and balances ma ọ bụ ikike a na-eji taa. Ịgụ data O mezughị omume graf dị na Nkuzi 5. O mezuru omume graf nke Nkuzi 5 nwere nkwubi okwu na-anọ n'ime data ahụ. Ọ kọwakwara mgbanwe ọnụ ahịa site n'iji supply na demand. Atụmatụ ọmụmụ Enweghị atụmatụ ọmụmụ, ma ọ bụ enweghị ụbọchị. Atụmatụ ọmụmụ nwere opekata mpe otu ụbọchị kwa izu ruo izu e chere ide ule. O nwekwara ụbọchị maka GED Ready ma ọ bụ ụbọchị ule e debere. Iji gafee: Ruru eru ma ọ bụ Karịrị n'ahịrị ọ bụla. Ọ bụrụ na ahịrị bụ Ọ ruchabeghị, gụghachi akụkụ ahụ nke akwụkwọ ahụ ma dozie azịza gị.

check.q: Ndị nnọchiteanya na Constitutional Convention dere Preamble n'afọ 1787. Kedu ụdị isi iyi ọ bụ?
check.why: Ndị dere Constitution mere ya n'oge ahụ.

check.q: Articles of Confederation hiwere gọọmentị mba na-adịghị ike. Gịnị bụ otu ihe si na ya pụta?
options: E mechiri Congress ruo mgbe ebighị ebi
check.why: Adịghị ike nke Articles dugara na Constitution nke 1787.
